cards.back: Situation · Task · Action · Result
cards.gloss: A clear structure for an interview example.

cards.back: I reduced the processing time by 30%.
cards.gloss: Choose a concrete outcome rather than a general claim.

cards.back: Practise is the verb; practice is the noun.
cards.gloss: I practise daily. Daily practice helps.

cards.back: A polite way to ask for a clearer explanation.
cards.gloss: Useful in meetings and interviews.

cards.back: “In my previous role, we needed to…”
cards.gloss: 情境: set the scene in 1–2 sentences.

cards.back: “My responsibility was to…”
cards.gloss: 任务: your specific goal.

cards.back: “I decided to… / I built… / I coordinated…”
cards.gloss: 行动: say I, not we.

cards.back: “As a result, … improved by … / which led to…”
cards.gloss: 结果: quantify if possible.

cards.back: “That's a great question. Let me think for a second.”
cards.gloss: Pause calmly instead of filling with um.

cards.back: “One area I've been working on is… so I've started…”
cards.gloss: Name the weakness, then show the fix.

cards.back: “What draws me to this role is… and it connects directly to my work on…”
cards.gloss: Link the role to your experience.

cards.back: “Thank you for your time. I'm really excited about the chance to contribute to…”
cards.gloss: End warmly and specifically.

cards.back: “I used data analysis to identify…, which helped the team decide…”
cards.gloss: Skill → action → decision.

cards.back: “As a result, we delivered ___ % of the data we needed / YOLO reached ___.” Fill ONE number you can defend.
cards.gloss: 结果必须带数字. Vague praise is not a Result.

cards.back: ark-JEE-eye-ess Pro · “I tried annotating the sites in ArcGIS Pro, but coverage was still too thin.”
cards.gloss: Say each letter of GIS slowly: G-I-S.

cards.back: YOH-loh (You Only Look Once) · “Our YOLO model detected older pedestrians in the street-view frames.”
cards.gloss: Two syllables: YO-LO. Not “yolo” mumbled as one blur.

cards.back: C-S-D-I A-P-I · “I proposed the Hong Kong government CSDI API for spatial data.”
cards.gloss: Spell both acronyms letter by letter.

cards.back: PAN-duz · “I ran a Python pilot with pandas to check the CSDI sample.”
cards.gloss: Like the animal. Not “pan-DAS”.

cards.back: “The purpose was to [deliver X] so that [another team / the project could Y].”
cards.gloss: 目的句: purpose + so that. Put this in Task or early Action.

cards.back: Situation = the messy context (patchy SVI, project stalled). Task = YOUR job (deliver a usable dataset + analyse features).
cards.gloss: 情境 vs 任务. Don’t merge them into one blurry paragraph.

cards.back: a single perfect fix · “There is no magic bullet for better sleep — diet is only one factor.”
cards.gloss: 万能药 / 一招解决. Use it about sleep research, not your STAR.

cards.back: to give your body useful signals through food · “Evening meals can feed information to your sleep system.”
cards.gloss: 向身体“投喂”信息. Not about social-media feeds.

cards.back: useful substances in food · “Researchers asked which nutrients support deeper sleep.”
cards.gloss: 营养素. Harder: use it in a sentence about sleep research.

cards.back: being told no; an idea or application refused · “Every rejection told me something about the role.”
cards.gloss: 被拒绝. Harder: say one sentence about job applications using it.

cards.back: to increase suddenly · “Applications spike in September.”
cards.gloss: 骤增. Verb and noun: a spike in demand.

cards.back: worried about talking to people or being judged · “I used to feel socially anxious in group interviews.”
cards.gloss: 社交焦虑. Stress: SO-shuh-lee ANG-shus.

cards.back: become easier to do · “Speaking up comes easier with practice.”
cards.gloss: 变得更容易. Note: comes easier, not ‘more easy’.

cards.back: feeling everything must be perfect · a safe ‘weakness’ if you show how you manage it
cards.gloss: 完美主义. per-FEK-shuh-ni-zuhm.

cards.back: to judge or assess · “I appraised each data source against our protocol.”
cards.gloss: 评估. Formal; good in STAR Action lines.

cards.back: Present (who I am now) → Past (proof: projects) → Future (why this role)
cards.gloss: 自我介绍三段式: 现在→过去→未来. 60 秒内.

cards.back: “I'm an urban analytics graduate from HKU, and I turn spatial data into decisions.”
cards.gloss: 第一句要短、有力. Say it without notes.

cards.back: make a range smaller and more precise · “This let the team narrow down the distance buffer.”
cards.gloss: 缩小范围. STAR #2 key verb.

cards.back: a change that repeats by season · “Older residents were mainly active in spring and winter.”
cards.gloss: 季节性规律. SEE-zuh-nuhl.

cards.front: buffer (GIS) — say it in a sentence
cards.back: the zone around a feature within a set distance · “a 2–3 station buffer around each estate”
cards.gloss: 缓冲区. BUF-er, not boo-fer.

cards.back: ri-GRESH-un uh-NAL-uh-sis · stress on GRESH and NAL
cards.gloss: 回归分析. Two stresses; don't flatten them.

cards.back: SPAY-shul · JEE-oh-SPAY-shul
cards.gloss: 空间的 / 地理空间的. Not spa-tee-al.

cards.back: Insight line between Action and Result · “The key insight was that most trips stayed within two to three MTR stations.”
cards.gloss: 关键发现是…. Use once per STAR.

cards.back: Result linker: outcome for OTHERS, not just you
cards.gloss: 这让团队得以…. Fixes Sat's purpose-sentence slip.

cards.back: shows initiative · “I took ownership of the SVI pipeline.”
cards.gloss: 我主动负责…. Stronger than ‘I was responsible for’.

cards.back: a balance between two good things · “The trade-off was coverage versus image quality.”
cards.gloss: 权衡取舍. Interviewers love hearing you name one.

cards.back: a person or team affected by your work · “I shared the dataset with the partner team, a key stakeholder.”
cards.gloss: 利益相关方. STAYK-hol-der.

cards.back: “I treat a no as feedback: I ask what was missing, adjust, and try again.”
cards.gloss: 如何面对被拒. Ties BBC topic to interviews.

cards.front: “If I did it again, I would…”
cards.back: reflection line after Result; shows learning · second conditional
cards.gloss: 如果重来我会…. would + verb, not will.

cards.back: dis-er-TAY-shun
cards.gloss: 毕业论文. Stress on TAY.

cards.front: “I'm keen to bring … to this role.”
cards.back: closing line of the 60-sec intro · “I'm keen to bring my GIS and Python skills to this role.”
cards.gloss: 我希望把…带到这个岗位. keen = eager, British.

cards.front: “I'm an urban analytics graduate from HKU, and I work with geospatial data.”
cards.back: 60-sec intro, PRESENT opener: who you are now (1 sentence).
cards.gloss: 现在: 我是谁。Start here, not with your childhood.

cards.front: “Most recently, I worked as a research assistant on…”
cards.back: PAST bridge: ‘…an ageing-friendly city project at HKU.’
cards.gloss: 过去: 最近的经历。most recently = 最近一段

cards.front: “Before that, I studied urban studies at Sheffield.”
cards.back: PAST, earlier step. Keep it to one line.
cards.gloss: 更早: 一句带过

cards.back: FUTURE close: ‘…apply spatial analysis to real planning decisions.’
cards.gloss: 未来: 接下来想做什么

cards.front: “What draws me to this role is…”
cards.back: Why-this-job opener; then ONE specific thing about the team/company.
cards.gloss: 吸引我的是… draw = 吸引

cards.back: ✓ Data work comes naturally to me. ✗ comes easier (needs ‘than’). ✓ It comes more easily now.
cards.gloss: 对我来说很自然。Monday's miss: 'comes easier'

cards.back: practical, done yourself: ‘hands-on experience with ArcGIS Pro’
cards.gloss: 亲手做的、实操的

cards.back: whole process start→finish: ‘I built the pipeline end-to-end, from API to map.’
cards.gloss: 从头到尾全流程

cards.back: people affected by / caring about the project: planners, residents, funders
cards.gloss: 利益相关方。stress on STAKE

cards.back: ‘I derive insights from street-level imagery.’ derive = get from (formal)
cards.gloss: 从…中得出洞见

cards.back: make a process simpler/faster: ‘I streamlined the image download with the CSDI API.’
cards.gloss: 简化、精简流程

cards.back: ‘…detail-oriented and curious.’ Then PROVE it with one example.
cards.gloss: 我会形容自己是… (后面要有例子)

cards.front: Action, step 1: “First, I cleaned the activity data and split it by season and by location.”
cards.back: Start the Action with ONE concrete step, using ‘I’, not ‘we’.
cards.gloss: 行动第一步：先说你自己做的具体动作

cards.front: Action, step 2: “Then I mapped where older residents were active compared with MTR stations.”
cards.back: ‘compared with’ links two things. Keep the steps in order: First → Then.
cards.gloss: 第二步：画图对比 MTR 站

cards.front: Action, insight: “I noticed a clear pattern: most activity happened within two to three MTR stations.”
cards.back: ‘I noticed a clear pattern:’ + colon + the finding. This is your hook.
cards.gloss: 发现规律

cards.front: Action, seasonal: “They were mainly active in spring and winter.”
cards.back: ‘mainly active in + season’. No ‘the’ before spring/winter here.
cards.gloss: 季节规律，季节前不加 the

cards.front: Action, initiative: “I took the initiative to flag this to the team and suggest a narrower buffer.”
cards.back: ‘took the initiative to + verb’ = did it without being asked.
cards.gloss: 主动提出

cards.front: Result: “As a result, the team narrowed the distance buffer for the regression analysis.”
cards.back: Open the Result with ‘As a result,’. Say what CHANGED for the team.
cards.gloss: 结果：团队缩小了距离缓冲区

cards.front: Result, why it matters: “…which made the model more focused on where older residents actually go.”
cards.back: ‘which made…’ adds the impact. Don't invent numbers; say the real change.
cards.gloss: 影响：模型更聚焦

cards.front: Reflection: “Looking back, I learned that a quick descriptive check can save a lot of modelling time.”
cards.back: Optional last line after R: what you learned. Keep it to one sentence.
cards.gloss: 反思：一句话

cards.front: Say it right: regression · buffer · descriptive
cards.back: ri-GRESH-un · BUFF-er · dis-KRIP-tiv
cards.gloss: 发音：回归 · 缓冲区 · 描述性

cards.back: narrow the buffer = make the range smaller · narrow down the options = reduce the choices
cards.gloss: narrow 缩小（范围） · narrow down 筛选

cards.back: As a result, the team narrowed the distance buffer for the regression analysis.
cards.gloss: 结果：团队缩小了回归分析的距离缓冲区

cards.back: …which made the model more focused on where older residents actually go.
cards.gloss: which made… 使得……（结果的影响）

cards.back: I flagged the pattern so that the team could choose a tighter buffer.
cards.gloss: so that 后面写别人能做到什么

cards.back: I cleaned the data by season so that we could compare spring and winter.
cards.gloss: 过去时：so that + could + 动词原形

cards.back: I took the initiative to suggest a narrower buffer.
cards.gloss: 主动去做 = took the initiative to + 原形

cards.back: Looking back, I learned that a quick descriptive check can save a lot of modelling time.
cards.gloss: 回顾：快速描述性检查能省大量建模时间 · descriptive = dis-KRIP-tiv

cards.back: On an AI data-centre policy research programme, I was the sole analyst, and the scope was ambiguous.
cards.gloss: STAR #3 情境：唯一分析员 + 范围模糊 · sole = SOHL

cards.back: My task was to build a defensible evidence base, even though the requirements were unclear.
cards.gloss: 任务：可站得住脚的证据基础 · defensible = di-FEN-si-bul

cards.back: First, I pushed for a working definition of what counts as an AI data centre, so the whole analysis shared one scope.
cards.gloss: 先推动工作定义，统一范围 · pushed for = 争取

cards.back: Second, I mapped the data gaps: I counted which indicators Hong Kong was missing and compared them with other regions.
cards.gloss: 梳理数据缺口 · indicators = IN-di-kay-turz

cards.back: Because the direction kept shifting, I built an iterative workflow, and after every meeting I kept a written log of what we agreed.
cards.gloss: 迭代流程 + 会议记录 · iterative = IT-er-uh-tiv

cards.back: As a result, I delivered a baseline analysis of data-centre governance, plus a clear list of the data Hong Kong is still missing.
cards.gloss: 结果：基线分析 + 缺失数据清单 · governance = GUV-er-nunss

cards.back: I stayed neutral and kept written notes of the agreed direction, deliverables and deadlines, so changes were visible to everyone.
cards.gloss: 追问：方向变动 → 中立 + 书面记录（不甩锅）

cards.back: I treated the gaps as a finding: the list of missing indicators became one of the outputs.
cards.gloss: 追问：缺数据 → 缺口本身成为成果

cards.back: Based on the data available, my working assumption was… and I flagged it clearly.
cards.gloss: 模糊情境下的稳妥说法 · flagged = 明确标注

cards.back: I took the initiative to propose a working definition before the analysis started.
cards.gloss: took the initiative + to + 动词（第3次巩固）

cards.front: Follow-up: "Without peer review, how did you check quality?"
cards.back: I cross-checked my figures against other regions' data, and I stated my assumptions and data gaps openly.
cards.gloss: 没有同行评审时如何保证质量 · point → reason → example

cards.back: able to be justified · "I built a defensible evidence base."
cards.gloss: 站得住脚的 · stress on FEN

cards.back: how something is managed and regulated · "data-centre governance mechanisms"
cards.gloss: 治理 · stress on GUV
